Name: Caramel Whispers Dessert Shop
Author: YellowSlime233
Description:
[b][size=5]Description | 描述[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]中文[/size][/b]
你们好！这是一套以甜品店为主题的家具套装，因为饱和度比较高所以我将它命名为「焦糖蜜语」。
这是我对高饱和度配色的一次尝试，希望你们能喜欢这些家具！
[b][size=4]English[/size][/b]
Hello everyone!
This is a furniture set inspired by a sweet little dessert shop, named Caramel Whispers.
This set is also an experiment with a more saturated color palette. I hope these warm and sweet colors can bring something a little different to your farm!
Thank you for checking out my work! I hope you enjoy these pieces and have fun creating your own cozy little dessert shop!

[size=5][b]Installation instructions | 安装说明[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
下载并解压文件。
将解压后的整个文件夹放入 Stardew Valley 的
Mods
文件夹中。
确保已安装所有必需的前置 Mod。
启动游戏即可使用。
[b][size=4]English[/size][/b]
Download and extract the archive.
Place the entire extracted folder into your Stardew Valley
Mods
folder.
Make sure all required mods are installed.
Launch the game and enjoy!

[b][size=5]Main features | 主要内容[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]中文[/size][/b]
包含示例图中展示的全部家具。
额外包含 3 款墙纸和 3 款地板。
本套装基于 Furniture Framework 制作，所有家具均可在罗宾的商店购买，如果想要使用壁纸和地板，需要下载AT。
关于展示图片：
第一张图片是我在绘图软件中制作的整体设计图，主要用于展示家具内容和布局，并不代表游戏内的实际摆放效果。
游戏内的实际效果请参考后续的装修展示图。
值得注意的是，在制作游戏内展示图时，我使用了精密移动 Mod，让家具布局更加协调。(我个人比较喜欢紧凑的装修)，因此也非常推荐你使用这个 Mod 来获得类似的摆放效果！
[b][size=4]English[/size][/b]
Includes all furniture pieces shown in the preview images.
Also includes 3 wallpaper designs and 3 flooring designs.
This furniture set is made with Furniture Framework. All furniture items can be purchased from Robin's shop. If you want to use wallpapers and floors, you need to download AT..
About the preview images:
The first image is a complete furniture layout arranged in my drawing software. It is intended to showcase all the included items and their designs, rather than their actual in-game appearance.
Please refer to the following in-game screenshots to see how the furniture looks in Stardew Valley.
One thing worth mentioning: I used the Precise Furniture Placement Mod when creating the in-game showcase, which allowed me to arrange the furniture more harmoniously. I personally love compact layouts filled with lots of little details, haha! So I highly recommend using it if you enjoy this kind of decorating style too!

[b][size=5]Requirements | 前置要求[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]中文[/size][/b]
必需前置：
SMAPI
Furniture Framework
推荐 Mod（非必需）：
精密移动 Mod（Precise Furniture Placement）
精密移动 Mod 并非本家具套装的强制要求，但强烈推荐安装。
[b][size=4]English[/size][/b]
Required:
SMAPI
Furniture Framework
Recommended (Optional):
Precise Furniture Placement
Precise Furniture Placement is not required for this furniture set, but it is highly recommended.

如果你喜欢我的创作，欢迎关注我的小红书账号：
